name: Bound Beyond
detailed_description:
Asheley Mane is missing. For you—a detective and owner of a small agency—this isn’t just another case. It’s your ticket out. Out of the endless “missing pet” grind and into the big leagues. Finding out what happened to one of archaeology’s brightest stars? That’s prestige. That’s clients. That’s finally the moment to prove you’re not just another wannabe, but a qualified professional with a degree and nerves of steel.

This was supposed to be it—the case of a lifetime. A chance to grab fortune by the tail. But what you find behind the ordinary-looking door of the Mane house… is nothing like a simple kidnapping. Within hours, the walls seem to whisper: something’s gone very. Very wrong. Your investigation twists into a strange, supernatural adventure. And now the real question isn’t whether you’ll make a name for yourself… it’s whether you’ll make it out alive.

WHERE LOGIC FAILS

In Bound Beyond, the deeper you dig, the stranger it gets. Silence turns menacing. Clues lead you into a world of ancient symbols and rituals, their origins lost somewhere far in the East.

GUESTS ARE NOT WELCOME

The mansion should be empty. Should be but... upstairs, you hear footsteps. Someone’s here. One person? More?.. Whoever they are, their goal is clear: stop you from uncovering the truth. The further you go, the sharper and deadlier the threat becomes.

HER HOUSE IS ONLY THE BEGINNING

The trail will lead you far beyond the archaeologist’s home. Every new location brings fresh puzzles, new evidence, and another step toward the answer. A temple. Catacombs. An abandoned factory. Each hides its own secrets. But wait… how did you even end up here?

THE ART OF BEING DETECTIVE

Your sharp mind is your greatest weapon — but in this case, you’ll also need tools and weapons. The world around you isn’t just set backdrop — it’s your tactical arsenal and a source of clues.

  • Explore the interactive world: open every door, cabinet, and drawer. That suspicious bookshelf? Could be hiding a secret compartment—or the key to a puzzle. Search for the story - hidden items, old documents will uncover it.

  • Use your gear: a gun, UV light, flashlight, camera, and, just in case, a lighter.

  • Noise indicator: your tactical compass—remember, your enemy hears everything. The crash of a broken statue might be the last sound you hear. Keep it quiet.

  • Physics matter: empty bottle or full? Just picture their face when you hit them with a cup of hot coffee

YOUR STYLE - YOUR RULES

Go full stealth, avoiding danger at every turn, or face threats head-on — after all, you’ve got a gun.

The mystery is waiting for its detective :)

Our team is actively adding new puzzles and features—add Bound Beyond to your Steam Wishlist to make sure you don’t miss the news and release.

DISCLAIMER

This game is currently in development. All showcased gameplay, visuals, and features represent a work in progress and are subject to change. Final content may differ from what is shown.

short_description: Immerse yourself in a dark and mystical adventure. Uncover the truth behind a famous archaeologist's disappearance. Explore diverse locations where every shadow could be an enemy, and every sound might be your last mistake. Survive and unravel an ancient secret—before it consumes you.

English*, German, Polish, Russian, French, Italian, Spanish - Spain
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1650 / AMD Radeon RX 5500
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Best experience if the game is installed on SSD.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 / AMD Ryzen 5 5500
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2070 / AMD RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Best experience if the game is installed on SSD

content_descriptors.notes:
This game features intense psychological horror elements and a tense, fear-driven atmosphere. It includes:
- Frightening imagery and sustained dread
- Encounters with supernatural entities
- Use of firearms in self-defense
- Themes of death and isolation

Occasional jump scares and disturbing audio/visual effects

While not graphically violent, the game is intended to unsettle and scare. Player discretion is advised.
